## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; mixed internals with Technology and Energy showing strong single-stock leadership while most sectors lag, supporting a neutral posture. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Top performers are Technology) and mixed sector returns confirm the neutral call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology lead: META (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +10.96% | 1M: +2.15%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%) ABOVE TREND. Energy also showing pockets of strength: PSX (1W: +6.77% | 1M: +5.23%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +6.53% | 1M: +9.91%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials, Healthcare and Consumer Staples are lagging overall: Materials weak with PPG (1W: -6.84% | 1M: +0.34%) CORRECTION; Healthcare soft with ABBV (1W: -4.98% | 1M: +10.05%) CORRECTION; Consumer Staples with PEP (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -3.78%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: META (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +10.96% | 1M: +2.15%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +8.14% | 1M: -6.04%) RECOVERY, CSCO (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +1.17%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — top performance concentrated in Tech.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: INTC (1W: -8.73% | 1M: +1.78%) CORRECTION, LOW (1W: -6.98% | 1M: -2.64%) BELOW TREND, PPG (1W: -6.84% | 1M: +0.34%) CORRECTION, PANW (1W: -6.36% | 1M: +25.10%) CORRECTION, NFLX (1W: -5.51% | 1M: -9.88%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated among select high-volatility and late-cycle names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: META (1W: +14.81%), AVGO (1W: +10.96%), NVDA (1W: +8.28%), CSCO (1W: +8.05%), AMD (1W: +7.74%) — all showing strong short-term flows into Tech. Divergence: several large-cap names show 1W vs 1M conflicts (many CORRECTION labels) but not a major divergence across core mega-caps.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is the engine but narrow: META (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +2.17% | 1M: +8.53%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.38% | 1M: -4.54%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -8.73% | 1M: +1.78%) CORRECTION — sector strength concentrated in a few names.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are constructive: SCHW (1W: +6.31% | 1M: +16.17%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.05% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND; overall Financials up 1W: +1.16% and 1M: +6.76% (20 stocks) indicating selective strength but not broad market leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare showing strain and rotation: ABBV (1W: -4.98% | 1M: +10.05%) CORRECTION, JNJ (1W: -2.30% | 1M: +8.43%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -0.17% | 1M: +3.40%) CORRECTION — defensive names not firmly leading; sector 1W: -1.58% signals caution.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to selective Technology and Financial names showing ABOVE TREND momentum (META, AVGO, SCHW) while reducing exposure to names showing CORRECTION or BELOW TREND (INTC, NFLX, PEP). Style: Growth/Momentum tilt but narrow leadership suggests being selective and monitoring breadth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: META (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +10.96% | 1M: +2.15%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -8.73% | 1M: +1.78%) CORRECTION, NFLX (1W: -5.51% | 1M: -9.88%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology — narrow leadership; watch whether strength broadens beyond top megacaps (Tech 1W: +2.14% | 1M: +1.44%). BEARISH: Materials and Healthcare — both 1W negative and showing multiple CORRECTION patterns.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
META near extension; watch pullback levels for consolidation. NVDA continuation above recent breakout levels to confirm broader tech participation. INTC support test on heavy weekly drop would signal risk if broken.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
AAPL (+65): Apple (1W: +2.17% | 1M: +8.53%) ABOVE TREND — headline on Broadcom deal confirms price strength. AVGO (+65): Broadcom (1W: +10.96% | 1M: +2.15%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price confirming. META (+55): Meta (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND — chip push headline aligns with strong accumulation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (-50): Boeing (1W: -1.86% | 1M: +3.62%) CORRECTION — negative headlines align with short-term softness and trend exhaustion. (News counts show broader mixed negative headlines in Industrials; monitor volume and follow-through.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt but narrow leadership concentrated in Technology. META (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +10.96% | 1M: +2.15%) ABOVE TREND and SCHW (1W: +6.31% | 1M: +16.17%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow tech concentration and multiple CORRECTION/RECOVERY signals across large names — monitor sentiment-driven flows for confirmation.
